plugin.name: Conversations
pick: Pick a conversation to read it here.
empty.wanted: Nobody is waiting for the team.
empty.heading: No conversations yet
empty.description: They show here as soon as a visitor writes in the chat.
status.yours: You hold this conversation: the assistant stays quiet until you hand it back.
status.held: {name} holds this conversation: the assistant stays quiet.
status.wanted: Waiting for someone of the team: {reason}
status.assistant: The assistant answers. Take the conversation over to answer yourself.
status.closed: Closed. The assistant answers if the visitor writes again.
status.closed_team_only: Closed. It comes back to To take if the visitor writes again.
events.wanted: The assistant handed it to the team
events.wanted_visitor: The visitor asked for someone of the team
events.wanted_message: The visitor wrote to the team
events.back: {by} handed it back to the assistant
note.label: Note by {name}
note.hint: Only your team sees it. The visitor and the assistant never do.
reply.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line. "/" for a saved reply.
reply.take_over_first: Take the conversation over to answer the visitor.
actions.take_from: {name} holds this conversation. Take it over from them?
actions.close_description: The conversation leaves your work, and nothing is deleted. The visitor reads that it is closed.
panel.title: About the visitor
saved.shortcut_help: Type "/" and this word in a reply to insert the text.
saved.empty_help: Write the answers your team gives often, then insert them in a reply with "/".
browser.title: Someone is waiting
browser.body: {count, plural, one {# conversation waits for the team} other {# conversations wait for the team}}
error: That did not work. Try again.
not_yours: This conversation is no longer yours: your reply was not sent.
